fact: HCP published the first Q1 2026 results of the new national labour force survey (EMO2026), which replaces the Enquete nationale sur l'emploi and has an annual sample of 135,000 households.
The 2024 national census (RGPH 2024) was taken, giving a legal population of 36,828,330 at 1 September 2024.
The government adopted decree 2.24.1009 fixing the legal population by region, province and commune from the RGPH 2024 results; date is the document's published date.
HCP's analysis of disability draws on the RGPH 2024 national census, which was taken in 2024.
The RGPH 2024 census counted 36.8 million inhabitants in 2024, including 148,152 foreign residents, with a new immigration module.
The High Commissioner's World Statistics Day 2025 address cites the 2024 General Population and Housing Census (RGPH 2024) as carried out; it gives no enumeration day or count.
